title: Account Executive, Enterprise
jobDescription:
At Atlassian, we are on a mission to unleash the potential of every team by revolutionising the software development industry, helping teams around the world like the Williams Racing, Nasa, Nike, Pixar and Tesla to advance humanity through the power of software & collaboration. We have built a multi-billion-dollar, fast-growing software business with over 300,000 paying customers, hundreds of implementation partners, and millions of users around the globe. Our culture is open, welcoming, collaborative, and passionately focused on our customers’ success.

As an Enterprise Account Executive your role will be to build and implement an effective territory strategy to drive the growth and adoption of Atlassian’s portfolio of solutions and services with our largest enterprise customers. At the same time, we want you to be a champion for our customers, advocating for what they need and uncovering additional value we can add to their organisation. Working across a territory of many of Atlassian’s largest existing customers across India, you’ll work in tight coordination with our Channel Partners, Product Specialists, and our internal Marketing organisation to position value, elevating the relationship we have already built with our enterprise customers.

Our Enterprise Account Executives are consultative, solution orientated and creative. They are able to think strategically and effectively prioritise resources to meet the needs of our customers.

  • Develop and implement Territory and named Account plans geared at maximising expansion opportunities across a wide portfolio of Atlassian products.

  • Maintain full Account ownership while coordinating with a variety of account team stakeholders (e.g Solution Engineering, Sales Development & Customer Success) to ensure a seamless customer experience.

  • Work closely with colleagues in the internal Atlassian Channel team as well as our extensive network of external Partners to build and execute on effective sales strategies for your designated territory of named Accounts. Outstanding accomplishments are the result of great teamwork, and success at the enterprise level “takes a community”.

  • Strong interlock and engagement with our customer dedicated Technical Account Managers to understand technical initiatives and help drive business outcomes for our customers.

  • Engage customers with regular 1:1 meetings, executive engagements, roundtables and participation at larger Atlassian and Partner led events across the India region.

  • Ensure customers are fully educated on the value of Atlassian’s Cloud-based “System of Work” including our AI, Scaled Agile, Enterprise Service Management, Work Management & Dev Ops solutions.

  • Regularly exceed quotas and performance metrics from scaling engagements across your territory.

  • “Be the change you seek” and demonstrate open collaboration while helping Atlassian to continuously improve our ability to better serve our customers.

Minimum Required Experience:

  • Experience managing Enterprise customers across an India focused territory.

  • 15 or more years of sales experience in a business-to-business Saa S or consumption based pricing sales environment.

  • Experience managing key customer relationships and closing strategic sales opportunities.

  • Extensive experience utilising a CRM to achieve and correlate key performance metrics.

  • Building and leading territory & strategic account plans.

  • Experience leading or coordinating Account teams to drive successful customer outcomes.

  • Proven ability to proactively engage customers with a consultative, solution-orientated approach to uncover new opportunities and ways to add value.

  • Consistent track record of meeting or exceeding performance targets.

  • Can contribute to the overall team culture in a positive and impactful way.

Additional Experience:

  • Experience selling Saa S to Dev/IT audiences

  • Solution selling to VP and C-level Executives

  • Experience working alongside a Channel sales organisation

  • Familiarity with Atlassian's suite of products

  • Experience with both on-premise and cloud software solutions

  • Experience supporting customers with cloud migrations

title: Account Executive, Mid Market
jobDescription:
Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company.

Atlassian unleashes the potential of every team. Our agile & Dev Ops, IT service management and work management software helps teams organize, discuss, and complete shared work. The majority of the Fortune 500 and over 300,000 companies of all sizes worldwide - including NASA, Audi, Kiva, Deutsche Bank and Dropbox - rely on our solutions to help their teams work better together and deliver quality results on time. Our products include Jira Software, Confluence and Jira Service Management.

Our Mid-Market sales team is responsible for managing a portfolio of mid-sized customers. This includes identifying cloud first sales opportunities and cross-sell and user expansion opportunities, nurturing customer relationships, and achieving revenue targets. We expect you to serve as a strong advocate for our customers by providing valuable feedback to our product and engineering teams, contributing to the enhancement of our customer experience. All of these responsibilities will be carried out in close collaboration with our Channel Partners, Product Specialists, Account Managers, and Solution Engineers. We share a commitment, as a TEAM, in guiding and aiding our customer’s deployment and utilisation of Atlassian at scale. However, above all we believe in the Atlassian values and use them as our compass as we continue to evolve our revolutionary sales model.

  • Develop and implement named Account or Territory (India) plans geared at both maximising expansion opportunities across a wide portfolio of products and ensuring high bar of customer success.

  • Developing and execute strategies to drive growth and engagement within the mid-market segment.

  • Identify and qualify opportunities within the defined mid-market customer segment.

  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with mid-market clients, understanding their business needs, and proposing suitable solutions.

  • Conducting product demonstrations and presentations to showcase the value proposition to potential clients.

  • Collaborating with internal teams, Channel Partners, Product Specialists, Account Managers, and Solution Engineers to streamline processes and enhance overall customer satisfaction.

  • Providing regular updates and reports to management on progress and outcomes.

  • Staying updated on industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor activities within the mid-market segment.

  • Traveling occasionally to meet clients, attend industry events, conferences, and intentional togetherness gatherings as required.

  • 8+ years of Enterprise Software Sales Experience

  • Experience growing mid-market accounts with India-based customers

  • Experience creating alignment and orchestrating internal account teams

  • Experience managing key customer relationships.

  • Extensive experience utilising a CRM to achieve and correlate key performance metrics

  • Building and leading territory account plans

title: Customer Success Manager
jobDescription:
Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Atlassian is looking for an Enterprise Customer Success Manager

Atlassian Enterprise Customer Success Managers (CSMs) help customers realize the value in their Atlassian investment. They engage customers to unlock early and sustained outcomes by delivering standard methodologies at scale that support product adoption, solution expansion, and long-term growth of customer users. They are strategic partners who connect adoption to measurable business value, helping customers understand not only how to use Atlassian, but how to transform the way their teams work.

As an Enterprise CSM, you’ll build relationships and demonstrate an understanding of the Atlassian customer journey, guiding complex customers over their hurdles through proactive and programmatic engagement. You will bring a strong point of view, create urgency around the outcomes that matter, and constructively challenge customers to rethink how their workflows can evolve — especially as AI changes the way teams operate.

You'll use your solution expertise to cut across multiple products and solution practice areas. You’ll work with a variety of customer profiles including executives, administrators and multi-layered global teams to support the successful adoption and expansion of their Atlassian solution investment. You will be expected to develop technical fluency across Atlassian’s platform and AI capabilities, translate complex concepts into practical business outcomes, and engage the right technical and specialist partners when deeper expertise is required.

Your future team

With over 300,000 customers worldwide, Atlassian is helping organisations like NASA, IBM, Hubspot, Samsung and Coca-Cola unleash the power of every team through Atlassian Solutions.

With a focus on value, we help our customers understand how our products combine to create enterprise solutions that transform their business’s outcomes. We’re different from other organisations because we approach everything we do using our value of ‘play as a team'.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop a trusted advisor relationship with customers from C-Suite, to executives and global teams, helping them succeed with our platform and ensuring they receive maximum value from our solution throughout their lifecycle. Command the conversation with credibility, create momentum, and establish the urgency required to turn strategic intent into customer action.

  • Experience with Saa S business models and enterprise customer needs resulting in quantifiable outcomes.

  • Collaborate with the customer and Atlassian Account Team to develop customer Success Plans, including regular check-ins, QBRs (Quarterly Business Reviews), and strategic planning sessions. Anchor plans in measurable business outcomes, adoption signals, and value realization — not activity or product usage alone.

  • Manage post-sales activity for your customers through relationship-building, product expertise and execution.

  • Maintain an understanding of our products and solutions and speak with customers about the most relevant features for their specific requirements. Build and maintain practical technical fluency across Atlassian solutions, including AI capabilities, integrations, administration, governance, and configuration trade-offs.

  • Engage with your customers to unlock early and sustained product adoption and success with Atlassian Solutions. Treat adoption as the path to value realization: help customers activate the right capabilities, change behaviors, and demonstrate the outcomes achieved.

  • Mitigate churn through early risk identification, intervention, escalation and mitigation in partnership with your seasoned account team and in particular the Account Associate. Use data and customer signals to prioritize action, and be resourceful and scrappy in removing blockers when the path forward is unclear.

  • Be the Voice of the Customer to provide internal feedback on how Atlassian can better serve our enterprise customers.

Your Background

  • 5-8 years in Customer Success or account management with a track record managing Enterprise customers with a complex Saa S product portfolio. Experience leading strategic, multi-stakeholder engagements and influencing outcomes without direct authority.

  • Experience establishing yourself as a trusted advisor with customer partners to guide outcomes.

  • Experience using Success Plans to ensure goals are aligned from a business strategy perspective and success metrics are identified. Demonstrated ability to quantify value, connect adoption to business outcomes, and use data to guide prioritization and executive conversations.

  • Understanding of common Jira and Confluence end-user use cases and ways of working, with an ability to demonstrate those use cases, and understanding of configuration trade-offs. Technical fluency in Saa S platforms, workflows, integrations, data, governance, and AI-enabled use cases; able to facilitate discovery and challenge customers to reimagine how work gets done.

  • Experience making customers feel valued through quality service internally across product, sales, support and marketing to facilitate a seamless customer experience. Proven ability to orchestrate cross-functional teams, navigate ambiguity, and reprioritize quickly as customer needs and business priorities change.

  • Experience balancing a book of business in a customer-facing environment.

  • Fluency with AI concepts and emerging AI-enabled ways of working, with the curiosity and judgment to help customers identify high-value use cases, challenge legacy processes, and translate experimentation into measurable outcomes.

  • A compelling executive presence with the ability to communicate a clear point of view, create urgency, and motivate customers and internal stakeholders to act.

  • A scrappy, resourceful approach: comfortable operating with imperfect information, adapting priorities, and finding creative paths through ambiguity to deliver customer value.

  • Experience with Gainsight (or similar CRM tool), Salesforce and BI tools such as Tableau

title: Design Manager - JSM
jobDescription:
Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

At Atlassian, Design is about creating clarity, connection, and joy in how teams experience our products. We are building a unified experience that feels seamless across every tool, so customers can stay in flow and get the most out of our platform. AI sits at the heart of how we work and what we ship. It is reshaping how teams collaborate, how services get delivered, and how designers do their best work. If you care about design that takes a systems view, and you are genuinely excited about what is possible with AI, we would love to meet you.

Your future team

In Jira Service Management, we are rethinking service management around the people who need help and the teams who provide it. For helpseekers, that means making it easy to ask for help wherever they are, across the channels and workflows they already use. We want to anticipate needs, take friction out of the way, and resolve issues before people even notice there is a problem. For service agents, we are designing experiences that help them work alongside AI, get to the right context quickly, and find the information they need to solve problems with confidence.

We are looking for a Design Manager to help shape this future across service management and stretch these experiences into the wider Atlassian suite. This role suits someone who is comfortable in fast moving spaces, and who also knows how to scale proven experiences as they grow. You will bring strong business sense, real customer empathy, and the ability to connect customer problems to measurable business impact.

You will lead a team that spans India and Australia, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Research, and Content Design.

What you will do

  • Set a clear design vision for IT Services within Service Collection, and break it down into pieces your team can ship.

  • Partner with leadership and partner teams to shape AI features across Rovo and JSM, from helpseeker experiences to the way agents do their work.

  • Work alongside Designers, Engineers, Product Managers, Content Designers, Researchers, Marketers, and Analysts to ship thoughtful, high quality work.

  • Recruit, mentor, and grow a diverse design team across geographies, with a high bar for craft.

  • Build inclusive rituals and strong written communication habits so the team can do their best work, wherever they are.

  • Lead the way as your team adopts AI in their daily practice. Bring new tools into the workflow, change how the team researches, prototypes, and ships, and coach designers as the practice evolves.

  • Drive multiple initiatives from idea to launch, with clear ownership of the customer outcomes and business impact they deliver.

  • Communicate design plans clearly and persuasively to teammates, peers, and senior leadership.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

  • Five plus years managing designers, leading the work itself, shaping quality, and coaching designers through hard product problems.

  • Strong craft sensibility. You know what great design looks like and can show it. A design leader first, people manager second.

  • You have personally led your team through the shift to AI. You know the tools, you have changed how the team works because of them, and you have driven that change yourself, not simply observed it.

  • A genuine curiosity for AI and how it changes the practice of design. You are comfortable with the speed, ambiguity, and constant learning that comes with it, and you help others build the same habit.

  • Experience leading platform or complex conceptual work, ideally in Saa S or enterprise software.

  • You have managed teams across geographies before. You know how to lead asynchronously, respect timezones, and create space for everyone to contribute.

  • You ship in ambiguity. You can run several large projects in parallel without waiting for perfect clarity.

  • A strong written and verbal communicator who can influence senior leadership, product and engineering partners, and distributed teams.

  • A product designer at heart. You still get hands on, and you know what it takes to ship great work.

And ideally, you would also:

  • Have led a project that pulled multiple crafts together and delivered a measurable improvement for users.

  • Have led product or content designers across multiple, concurrent streams of work.

title: Head of Engineering, Commerce Platform
jobDescription:
As the Head of Engineering for the Core Commerce Platform, you will be the primary architect and leader of Atlassian’s next-generation monetization engine. This is a high-stakes leadership role at the intersection of engineering excellence, financial integrity, and business transformation. You will lead a department of 50–70 engineers in India, tasked with evolving our legacy billing systems into a world-class, enterprise-scale platform that powers Atlassian’s multi-billion dollar revenue stream.

Your mission is to build a unified, multi-modal billing platform that seamlessly integrates traditional seat-based models with modern, value-based consumption models. This platform is the "monetization backbone" that converts every customer interaction—from a Jira seat to an AI-powered Rovo credit—into accurate, transparent, and compliant revenue.

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

  • Platform Modernization: Transition the Commerce Cloud Platform (CCP) from a seat-centric system to a flexible, meter-agnostic engine capable of handling high-concurrency usage events and complex financial settlements.

  • Enterprise Readiness: Deliver "hardened" commerce capabilities for our largest customers, including aggregate quoting, threshold-based invoicing, and advanced credit management.

  • Financial Integrity & Compliance: Ensure 100% accuracy in revenue recognition (MRR/ARR) and downstream finance integrations. You will own the systems that interface with Stripe and internal financial reporting tools.

  • AI-Native Transformation: Drive the adoption of AI within the platform itself—leveraging AI for automated testing of complex commerce scenarios, anomaly detection in billing, and optimizing the "Usage Event → Invoice" pipeline.

Data is messy and hard — and it's the most critical, make-or-break input for Search and AI.

You will be expected to lead other engineers, drive technical direction within your scope, and own outcomes from design to launch.   • Make sound architectural trade-offs between freshness, correctness, cost, and operational simplicity — and own the outcomes within your scope.

  • Drive the simplification and modernization of complex, legacy data processing systems. Identify and eliminate unnecessary complexity. Design systems that are understandable, testable, and operable.

  • Apply and promote design patterns and best practices for handling the inherent messiness of real-world data — schema evolution, partial failures, eventual consistency, connector variability, and data quality degradation.

  • Own engineering and operational excellence for the health of systems and processes within your scope. Proactively identify opportunities for continuous improvement and track key operational metrics.

  • Improve developer productivity by championing agents, automation, and tooling that unlock team potential. Foster a culture of high ownership, rigorous testing, safe rollouts, and data-driven engineering.

  • Mentor engineers and contribute to building an open, innovative, and operationally responsible team culture.

You'll run disciplined experiments that validate whether changes to models, prompts, or retrieval actually move the needle - and build the infrastructure to run those experiments repeatedly and confidently. jobDescription:

About AI & ML Platform Team

The AI & ML platform team builds and runs the infrastructure that underpins dozens of Atlassian's AI, Machine Learning & Search capabilities across our wide range of products. Our mission is to democratise AI & Machine Learning for Atlassian’s teams, customers and ecosystem. We do this by creating foundational infrastructure and tools that are user-friendly and reliable - accelerating the development, deployment, measurement, and operation of AI & ML experiences. Our team owns infrastructure such as the platform we use to run advanced generative LLMs & other models, the GPU accelerated model serving platform teams across Atlassian use to deploy their own models, the data access and training infrastructure we are using to develop our next generation of in house AI, the feature stores we use to run personalised recommendations in production, and many other capabilities. We work very closely with our stakeholders - the product & search teams - to help navigate the rapidly evolving space and helping deliver Atlassian Intelligence features to customers.

AI & ML Platform Team teams are distributed across Australia, India, Singapore & the US, and sit within the Central AI organisation along side Search & Conversational AI teams.

You will work closely with our leadership group of the AI & ML Platform team, technical program managers, stakeholders & architects to influence the direction of the platform and plan the steps to get there - in the rapidly changing AI domain. You will be responsible for building effective teams, empowering them to achieve their goals, and putting those goals into a broader context. Your greatest responsibility will be looking after the individuals reporting to you – coaching and supporting them in their professional development, unlocking their potential, and challenging them to step outside their comfort zone to grow and excel. As a hands-on engineering leader, you will also contribute to the engineering and operational practices and bring in a continuous improvement mindset. As the AI space is evolving quickly - as a team close to the technology there is a great opportunity for thought leadership and helping influence the rest of the company on how they can use our platform best.

On their first day, we'll expect

  • Significant technical experience with building large-scale backend software / platforms

  • Experience leading, supporting & growing large development teams

  • Familiarity with agile software development methodologies

  • Ability to drive high technical standards, pushing innovation, quality, and operational excellence

  • Driving clarity from requirements and providing direction in ambiguous environments

  • Strong execution focus and proven track record of complex software delivery to production environments

It's great if you have

  • Experience in AI & ML or Data

  • Experience in defining a strategic roadmap for products and platforms

  • Experience with distributed development teams across multiple geographies

  • Continuous delivery with a strong bias for action

Your background

title: Senior Principal Engineer, Search Platform
jobDescription:
Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Your future team: Search Platform

The Search Platform team is responsible for powering Rovo Search, knowledge discovery and search for humans and agents across all enterprise data. Our mission is to make all our customers' data across Atlassian and their external apps (i.e. third-party applications) searchable securely and reliably through an insanely fast, globally scalable, cost-efficient, enterprise grade search infrastructure. Powering search and discovery in the agentic era is a whole new challenge and this team is at the forefront for Atlassian.

As a Senior Principal Engineer in Search Platform, you will own technical roadmap, execution and outcomes for the Search Data pillar. You will help envision, build and evolve a cutting-edge platform for integrating, processing, indexing and searching massive volumes of unstructured data across 100+ sources. Your deep expertise in large-scale data platforms, streaming and batch processing and distributed systems to solve some of our most complex problems including infrastructure, data and dev/agentic productivity challenges. Data is messy and hard and its the most critical, make or break input for Search and AI.

As a senior technical leader, you will be expected to lead other engineers to define our strategic technical direction, and to own outcomes from design to launch. Your role is pivotal in identifying and driving step-change initiatives, choosing the problems to solve vs not, in order to deliver a world-class end-to-end search experience, powered by rich data which is fresh, reliable across all apps.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Collaborate with technical leads, partner teams and internal customers to define technical strategy and architecture for Search Data.

  • Lead the evolution of our data platform and pipelines to meet the demands of both real-time search freshness and AI/agentic retrieval at enterprise scale.

  • Make hard architectural trade-offs between freshness, correctness, cost, and operational simplicity - and own the outcomes.

  • Drive the simplification and modernization of complex, legacy data processing systems. Identify and eliminate unnecessary complexity. Design systems that are understandable, testable, and operable.

  • Establish design patterns and best practices for handling the inherent messiness of real-world data - schema evolution, partial failures, eventual consistency, connector variability, and data quality degradation.

  • Own engineering and operational excellence for the health of our systems and processes. Proactively drive opportunities for continuous improvements and own key operational metrics.

  • Transform developer productivity to ensure that we unleash the potential of our own team with agents. Champion a culture of high ownership, rigorous testing, safe rollouts, and data-driven engineering across Search Data teams.

  • Help hire and mentor engineers to build an open, innovative and operationally responsible culture.

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Requirements:

  • Deep experience with distributed data frameworks (Kafka, Flink, Spark) - you have built, operated, and debugged systems processing billions of events per day. Ideally for Search and AI use cases where innovation relies on iterating over data. You understand their failure modes, not just their happy paths.

  • Strong background in designing data architectures that handle messy, heterogeneous data at scale - including schema evolution, data quality, idempotency, backfill/replay, and partial failure recovery.

  • Track record of simplifying complex systems. You have taken spaghetti systems and turned them into something engineers can reason about, test, and operate confidently.

  • Demonstrated department-level technical leadership, influence across multiple teams, and ownership of top-level technical objectives tied to business outcomes. You identify ambiguity and bring clarity.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals. Fluency in at least one modern language (Java preferred). You write code, review code, and hold a high bar for engineering quality.

  • Excellent communication skills. You can explain complex data architecture to engineers, product managers, and leadership with equal clarity.

  • 12+ years of experience imagining, building and operating critical systems at scale.
